lines.zh: 我挂在树上，慢慢往下挪。
lines.en: I hang from a branch and lower myself.

lines.zh: 长臂抓着树干，一点一点。
lines.en: Long arms grip the trunk, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我顺着藤往湿的地方挪。
lines.en: I creep along the vine toward the damp.

lines.zh: 我的动作很慢，像在省力。
lines.en: I move slowly, conserving effort.
My feet hug a branch and stop.

lines.zh: 我从树上下来，落到泥里。
lines.en: I come down into the mud.
The branch I hang from sways.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往沼泽那边。
lines.en: I go step by step toward the marsh.
I walk dragging long arms. Absurd.
I pass a dark tree and go around.
I wobble my way across.
I slowly climb higher.
I hang from a branch, still.
The swamp mist makes me sleepier still.
I have chewed this leaf for ages.
The bark is cool.
My claws dig into the bark.
I sit in the light that leaks through the leaves.

lines.zh: 我挑的枝子够撑一下午。
lines.en: The branch I chose will hold me all afternoon.
I know this forest well.
An insect crawls past my hand.

lines.zh: 我张开大嘴打了个呵欠。
lines.en: I open wide and yawn.
I hang from the branch with my toes hooked tight.
The smell of moss settles me down.
The sun is still high. I will doze.
Hanging in midair is comfortable.
You are shorter than the trees.
I watch you from up here.
I am not coming down. You come up.
I am slow. I do not chase.
I know this whole stretch.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里的东西。
lines.en: I smell what is in your pocket.
Coming down will take a while.
Do not shake this tree.
I hang here to save effort.
The marsh is that way.
I cannot reach you from under this tree.
I always do things slowly.
You are blocking my branch.
The leaves on this tree are mine.
You have looked up too long.
I cannot keep up at all.
I nearly fell out of the tree.
I slowly recoiled.
The blow spun me right around.
Hanging, I swung once.
It hurts, and I do not want to move.
My claws loosened.
I shifted to another branch.
The wound will close slowly.
I am still up in the tree.
Another hit would be a problem.
Is that pile dung?
Leave it right there.
I will climb over myself.
Two steps. Very tiring.
I like that smell.
Step back and I will come down.
Not enough to fill a tooth gap.
I am slow. Wait.
Leave it where it is.
This pile is very fresh.
I will carry it in my claws.
I lean in for a sniff.
You knocked into the tree.
I bumped the branch, and did not fall.
I am hanging above your head.
Do not shake this tree.
My claws lost their grip on the bark.
Not worth bothering about.

lines.zh: 我在地上摊了有一会儿。
lines.en: I lie spread out on the ground for a while.
Move. I cannot get past.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我的爪子。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my claws.
You take that end.
I am far too slow.
That takes effort.
I shuffle over and rub against my partner.
I will not answer that.
Hanging in a tree is better.
Ask someone else.
I find even walking tiring.
In a few days.
I must get back up the tree.
I cannot summon the energy.
There is a pile on the ground.
I climb down slowly.
I grab it, then cannot be bothered to open my paw.
Too heavy. I leave it.
This will not chew.
I carry it back up the tree.
This one is not bad.
I hide it in a fork.
Climbing down is too tiring.
Just leave it there.

lines.zh: 我压低的树枝正好够你。
lines.en: The branch I bent down reaches you perfectly.
I have my eye on you.
I let go of the branch and drop halfway.
You are under my eye.
The branches will block you.
I have felt every trunk here.
Three counts will do.
You backed to the marsh.
I am slow, but I arrive.
Do not run off.
I have hung here too long.
Time for me to come down.
I climb down from the tree.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的爪子就松开。
lines.en: The moment you move, my claws let go.
I hook a branch with my tail.

lines.zh: 我看着泥地绊了你一下。
lines.en: I watched the mud trip you.
I swing closer, slow as if asleep.
Slower is fine.
There is a root at your feet.
Hang a moment more.

lines.zh: 我把爪子垂到你的高度。
lines.en: I let my claws hang down to your height.
The trees are too dense here.
Good. Right here.
I wait for you to step into the mud.
A long arm swings across.
Claws come down from above.
I drop from the tree.
The claw I swing out lands blunt.
You dodged, and I struck half a beat late.
My claws land on your shoulder.
My second swipe grazes your shoulder.
My bones are heavy.
I pin you against the bark and rub.
Once I swat, I lean back on the trunk.
That one landed solidly.
I can reach from where I hang.
I poke my head from the fork.
These trees are tall.
First I hung a long while.
The marsh is close by.
I scratched the bark.
I open my eyes among the treetops.
Someone passes below.
I crane up at the canopy.
My long arms hang down.
This is a good place to sleep.
I sway to a stop.
I am hanging here.

lines.zh: 毛尖烧卷了，我龇了龇牙。
lines.en: The tips of my fur curl from the burn, and I bare my teeth.
The branch snaps and I crash into the rotten leaves.
In water I am even slower.
The blast snaps branches.
An arrow sticks in the branch I hold.
The light blurs my eyes.
There is little to eat in the trees.

lines.zh: 电打在树上，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and numbs me.
No tree to hang from.
